description_en: Retrieves the list of all error events under a specific aggregated error
description_zh: 获取某一聚合错误下所有的错误事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun emas-appmonitor get-errors --biz-module crash --utdid Z70g6V/MXJ8DABtD53eHzn4X --digest-hash -3481243636390427020 --filter '{"Operator":"and","Values":["1.1.0"],"SubFilters":["operator_:_in_,_key_:_osVersion_,_values_:_15.5"],"Key":"osVersion"}' --time-range EndTime=1740499200000 StartTime=1739894400000 --page-index 1 --page-size 10 --app-key 24780725 --os android --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetErrors
